newsitem.title: USA: Shell Transport final dividend raised.
newsitem.headline: Shell Transport final dividend raised.

text.p: Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc said the board recommended to the annual general meeting a final dividend equal to $2.73 per New York Share, compared to $2.31 last year.

The actual amount to be paid holders of New York Shares will be determined by the dollar/sterling exchange rate on May 21. The amount of $2.73 is based on the the current rate of $1.62 per pound sterling and an imputation tax credit rate of 20/80ths, the company said.
At that rate, the final dividend results in a total dividend for the year 1996 of $4.50, compared to 1995's $3.83.
The final dividend is payable May 28 to holders of New York Shares of record April 18, Shell said.
